welcome.title: Welcome to Automatarium
welcome.intro: This version of Automatarium is for classes at {{institution}}. Before you start, register your details: your files will be bound to your student ID and only you and your teacher will be able to open them.
welcome.control_help: As shown on your student card. With it you can open your files on your phone and your computer.
welcome.accept: I understand that I will not be able to change these details on this device without deleting all my work.
welcome.confirm_title: Check that your details are correct:
welcome.confirm_warning: If your student ID is wrong, your teacher will not be able to identify your submissions.
welcome.error_control: The student ID format is not valid.
welcome.error_name: Please enter your full name (first and last name).
welcome.error_accept: You must tick the box to continue.

student.dev_keys: Test build: submissions use development keys and are NOT secure.

tabs.close_confirm: Remove the tab "{{name}}" from this submission? This cannot be undone.
tabs.last_tab: A submission must have at least one automaton.
tabs.imported: Contains content imported from outside the app

submission.save_failed: The submission could not be saved.
submission.open_failed: The file could not be opened.
submission.wrong_student: This file belongs to a different student ID and cannot be opened in this app.
submission.tampered: The file was modified outside Automatarium and cannot be opened. If this was a mistake, ask your teacher for help.
submission.not_atec: The file is not an Automatarium Tec submission.
submission.replace_confirm: You already have a newer version of "{{name}}" on this device. Replace it with the one from the file?
submission.import_warning: Importing a file from outside the app adds it as a new tab. Your teacher will be able to see that this content was imported. Continue?

newfile.new_desc_fsa: Start a submission with a finite state automaton. You can add more tabs later.
newfile.new_desc_pda: Start a submission with a push down automaton. You can add more tabs later.
newfile.new_desc_tm: Start a submission with a Turing machine. You can add more tabs later.
newfile.delete_confirm: Delete the submission "{{name}}" from this device? If you did not save it as a file, it will be lost.

reset.label: Reset the app
reset.description: Deletes your registration and ALL work saved on this device. Only use it if you entered the wrong student ID.
reset.confirm: Your registration and all your submissions on this device will be deleted. Type your student ID to confirm:
reset.mismatch: The student ID does not match. Nothing was deleted.

install.ios: To install on iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
